contentText: US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu are meeting in Florida for talks that will cover the next phase of the Gaza ceasefire deal. Washington wants to see it move to the second phase in January 2026, but Israel and Hamas both accuse each other of breaching the first phase of the agreement. Andrew Hilliar breaks down where the deal currently stands and what's supposed to happen in phase two.
